name: datalineage-bigquery-asset-impact-analysis
description: >- Analyzes the downstream impact (blast radius) when a BigQuery table or view is broken, stale, or modified. Use when: - Performing a blast radius or impact analysis for a BigQuery table or view. - Assessing the consequences of modifying, deleting, or pausing updates to a BigQuery asset. - Identifying downstream dependencies (tables, dashboards, processes) of a BigQuery asset.
